purpose: Three existing public PDFs selected for the retrieval and trace evaluation suite. Tanmay reduced the original five-paper selection to its first three on 2026-10-03; the other two are outside the active suite.
selection_method: Python random.Random(seed).sample(sorted top-level regular non-symlink PDF paths, 5), without replacement; retain the first three after scope reduction. No redraw. Temporary download directories excluded.
